patch.summary: HTTP listener remains bound to literal 127.0.0.1.

artifact.format: APK/DEX ZIP, used as app_process classpath; no APK installation
artifact.signing: Unchanged upstream assembleDebug signing configuration; upstream public test key is not a trust credential.

build.sourceChanges: loopback-only.patch, package-catalog.patch and clipboard-safety.patch; no dependency, signing or entrypoint changes.
build.gitVersionMetadata: Source-archive build, no local Git identity/history is used. Generated APK version metadata may differ from the upstream release; Main does not reference BuildConfig.
build.reproducibility: Two fresh source/work directories using pinned inputs produced byte-identical maxa.3 artifacts (same SHA256).
build.scope: Linux x86_64; JDK, Gradle, SDK and user caches are isolated. No global PATH/profile/SDK changes.

staticVerification.bindChain: NanoHTTPD stores the non-null hostname; ServerRunnable.run constructs InetSocketAddress(String,int) and passes it to ServerSocket.bind(SocketAddress).
staticVerification.runtimeListenerCheck: App runtime /proc loopback enforcement remains required in addition to static verification.

packageCatalogPatch.summary: Maxa-owned GET /maxa/packages: launchable applications and display labels, or one package label, via the existing shell system-context PackageManager; no UiAutomation connection needed.

clipboardPatch.summary: Use primary ClipData to distinguish authorized empty clipboard from unreadable/non-text; require read before write, clear empty text restoration, remove clipboard listener and HTTP request-body logs.
